name: Itau Unibanco BRL Stablecoin
oneLiner: BRL-ITAU is a pre-launch stablecoin under evaluation by Brazil's largest private bank Itau Unibanco, with peg currency and design still undecided.
collateral: Pre-launch: Itau is evaluating a BRL- or USD-denominated stablecoin under Brazil's virtual-asset framework (BCB Resolutions 519 to 521, in force since February 2 2026). The bank took part in the DREX wholesale CBDC pilot and would source distribution rails and custody from its existing regulated infrastructure, but no reserve composition has been publicly committed.
pegMechanism: Pre-launch: peg maintenance is not yet defined, and Itau has made no issuance decision under the virtual-asset rules now in force. Itau is expected to use direct bank-issuer mint/redeem rails consistent with its existing custodial and FX infrastructure.

jurisdiction.regulator: Banco Central do Brasil (Resolutions 519/520/521 in force since February 2 2026)

launchPhaseDetail: Itau Unibanco (Brazil's largest private bank by assets, ~5.6T BRL) is evaluating its own stablecoin. Head of Digital Assets Guto Antunes confirmed exploration at an industry event in Sao Paulo in April 2025: 'we are always open to understanding whether it makes sense for our clients to have a stablecoin, even one in real, within Itau'. Brazil's virtual-asset framework (Consultas Publicas 109-111) was finalised as BCB Resolutions 519, 520, and 521 in November 2025 and took effect on February 2 2026; peg-currency choice (BRL or USD) and product timeline remain undisclosed. Itau participated in the DREX wholesale CBDC pilot, gaining distribution-rail experience; ticker not yet announced. Pharos tracks BRL as the most likely first launch given the Brazilian retail base, but the editorial summary documents the open USD option. BCB Resolution 561, dated April 30 2026, bars virtual assets in payments or receipts between an eFX provider and its foreign counterparty from October 1 2026. It does not name Itau. At Blockchain.RIO on August 13 2026 Antunes said stablecoins and tokenised deposits must coexist, without committing to an Itau-issued token. No source has given a launch timeline since the April 2025 remark, so Pharos removed the 2026 expectation on September 13 2026.

Itaú digital-assets head reiterates watchful stance; no own-stablecoin decision
milestones.description: Guto Antunes told BitNotícias that Itaú's crypto client base grew 252 percent since the December 2024 retail expansion and that the bank is closely tracking tokenization and stablecoins as potential enablers of new payment models. The Drex pilot has ended; no issuance decision, peg choice, ticker, or date has been announced.
